details:
New idea asset/inventory type Animations!

...what?

Lot of games have been adding animations into their projects such as team fortress 2, helldivers and Fortnite where you can play a animation and you can interact with other players, such as high five, hugs, complex dancing like a long tango line dance.

This is a VR game why would I want this? Well that's a great question, maybe you just want to some cool fighting moves without hurting yourself or physical reasons cant dance but want to be with the party theirs tons a reasons why someone would use this but mostly just for fun.

Other reasons if you brought a avatar from the store but wish you had cool dance animations now you can similar to the accessory system works

Just a new way to interact with people theirs tons of applications for such a feature.

So do this animations work in these other games normally lets says someone starts a dance animation and you go up to them press a button to prompt to start the dance animation with them even though you never bought it.

I feel the animations should also not be limited per avatar similar to accessory's

Thanks for reading I hope such a feature gets added into the game.
title: New idea asset/inventory type Animations! and gestures that can be interacted with other players that dont own it.
